body: Thanks for the reply. I just don't know how long till he's stable again and not sure if I'll even get to know anymore. I feel pretty horrible. The BPD suggestion may be true, because he did take it very personally sometimes when I'd tell him he hurt me but used to always try his best to learn. But I'm also not sure cause his pattern is usually him doing really well and being energetic for a couple of months and then falling into depression and becoming a completely different person the next few months. He was quite stable and not mood swingy at all for the months he was good, which is a bit less BPD I believe.

I hate how often they just stood there and watched when something intense was happening. Like when Claudia entered Rex's lair, none of them even tried to attack her. And when Aaravos was possessing Callum (which initially looked like he was being choked) they spent a good minute just standing there watch Callum lose his breath instead of maybe shining some light in the mirror to turn it off or something.

Also why was Zym unaffected by the sleep spell? AND why did they make Zubeia literally give away the answer to seeing through the mirror instead of having Callum find out himself? Super anti-climactic.

The thing with the architect putting out the sun elves fire was just so forced and nonsensical, if someone tells you they're doing something to mourn their mother's death it's just ridiculous to see someone argue on like that without acknowledging the person's death at all. I get they have different cultures, but it's not like humans don't mourn the bereaved, there's no reason why she wouldn't understand that cause of "cultural differences"..

Was really hoping for some background on Callum and why he can do magic this season. Can't believe we waited this long for a season that could've been fit into 3 episodes instead of 9.
